about: The prayer addresses Jesus and recalls Saint Bernardine’s love for His holy name. Through the saint’s merits and intercession, it asks for a spirit of love for Jesus.

seg.tr: Lord Jesus, You granted blessed Bernardine, Your confessor, an extraordinary love for Your holy name. Through his merits and intercession, we ask You graciously to pour into us a spirit of love for You. You live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: an extraordinary love for Your holy name
through his merits and intercession, we pray
into us a spirit of love for You
in the unity of the Holy Spirit

ex.w012: The holy name of Jesus is the object of Bernardine’s extraordinary love.
ex.w015: The community’s plea is offered through Bernardine’s merits and intercession.
ex.w019: The requested spirit is a disposition of love for Jesus. The conclusion separately names the Holy Spirit.
ex.w022: The prayer asks Jesus to give the community a disposition of love for Him.
ex.w024: Jesus is the gracious giver addressed by “graciously pour”. The recipient is the community at prayer.
ex.w036: Jesus is addressed throughout the prayer. The word “God” in this conclusion identifies Him as the Son who lives and reigns with the Father.

nt.w022: Love for Jesus is the contextual reading. The possessive can also suggest love coming from Him.
